scope.summary: Upstream lists this plugin in its marketplace with an external git source (microsoft/Dataverse-skills). It is not listed in this fork's marketplace: an external source would install unmirrored upstream content directly, bypassing this fork's sync policy, declared transforms, and telemetry exclusion.

blockers: Owner decision required: either mirror microsoft/Dataverse-skills into this fork under the sync policy, or keep the plugin out of the marketplace. Listing the external source as-is would install content this fork never reviews or transforms.
Internal owner and support channel are not assigned.
